---
title: "Preface"
---

# Who this guide is for

This free guide is for learners who want to understand, evaluate and build useful AI applications. Prior machine learning experience helps but is not required for the introductory chapters.

# How to use the guide

Read in order or use the hackathon pathway to start with a small problem. Examples shown in chapters are non-executable; runnable programs belong in `scripts/python/`, with optional wrappers in `scripts/bash/`.

# A learning commitment

Keep track of data sources, assumptions, tests, limitations and human review. A working demonstration is the beginning of evaluation, not evidence that a system is ready for real-world use.
